## Hypothesis

A sweep of recent structure with a large upper wick followed by a weak close indicates a liquidity grab and a likely short‑term reversal. The pattern captures engine P&L on J winner days while avoiding losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Let HH20 be the highest high of the prior 20 bars. If high > HH20 + 0.3*ATR20 (sweep) AND close < (open+high)/2 (bearish close) AND (high‑low) > 0 AND (high‑close)/(close‑low) > 2 (upper wick at least twice the lower wick/body), enter short at the close of that bar. Exit: stop placed above the sweep high (chart‑stop via BOS invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner using a premium‑stop trail of 6% of ATR20. Regime hint: optimal when VIX between 15 and 25, time 10:30-12:00, and 5‑minute EMA ribbon slope magnitude < 0.25% per bar.
